name: Green Packet Berhad
overview: Green Packet Berhad 今年以 RM9.98 million 收购 A Tech Insure Sdn Bhd 75% 股权，将保险科技纳入业务组合；同时 Kiplepay 与 Rural Capital Berhad 签署白标数字钱包 MOU，公司亦与 PRESMA 签署 MOU 推动穆斯林餐饮生态数字化。公司通过多次新股发行集资，并因财年结束日变更而出现两个年度财报期。
overview_en: Green Packet Berhad acquired a 75% equity stake in A Tech Insure Sdn Bhd for RM9.98 million this year, adding insurtech to its business portfolio; Kiplepay signed an MOU with Rural Capital Berhad for a white-label digital wallet solution, and the company also signed an MOU with PRESMA to digitalise the Muslim F&B ecosystem. The company raised funds through several new share issuances and changed its financial year end, resulting in two annual reporting periods.

segments.name: 数字服务
segments.note: Kiplepay 与 Rural Capital Berhad 签署白标数字钱包 MOU，并与 PRESMA 签署 MOU 推动穆斯林餐饮生态数字化。
segments.note_en: Kiplepay signed an MOU with Rural Capital Berhad for a white-label digital wallet and an MOU with PRESMA to digitalise the Muslim F&B ecosystem.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Kiplepay Sdn Bhd 与 Rural Capital Berhad 于 2026 年 4 月 16 日签署 MOU，探讨开发及实施白标数字钱包方案。
actions.text_en: Kiplepay Sdn Bhd and Rural Capital Berhad entered into an MOU on 16 April 2026 to explore the development and implementation of a white-label digital wallet solution.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Green Packet Berhad 与 Persatuan Pengusaha Restoran Muslim Malaysia (PRESMA) 于 2026 年 4 月 16 日签署 MOU，为 PRESMA 全国餐厅网络开发综合数字生态系统。
actions.text_en: Green Packet Berhad and Persatuan Pengusaha Restoran Muslim Malaysia (PRESMA) entered into an MOU on 16 April 2026 to develop an integrated digital ecosystem for PRESMA's nationwide restaurant network.

segments.name: 投资
segments.note: 公司以 RM9.98 million 收购 A Tech Insure Sdn Bhd 75% 股权，并多次调整付款安排。
segments.note_en: The company is acquiring a 75% equity stake in A Tech Insure Sdn Bhd for RM9.98 million, with several adjustments to the payment schedule.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司与卖方于 2026 年 11 月 17 日签署变更协议，余款 RM5,988,000 分五期每月支付 RM1,197,600，自 2026 年 11 月 30 日起。
actions.text_en: The company and the vendors entered into a variation agreement on 17 November 2026 for the final payment of RM5,988,000 to be paid in five monthly instalments of RM1,197,600 each, commencing 30 November 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司于 2026 年 10 月 29 日向卖方律师支付 RM2,994,000 作为第二笔付款，余款 RM5,988,000 将分五期每月支付 RM1,197,600。
actions.text_en: The company released RM2,994,000 to the vendors' solicitors as the second payment on 29 October 2026, with the final payment of RM5,988,000 to be paid in five monthly instalments of RM1,197,600 each.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司与卖方于 2026 年 7 月 8 日同意调整余额收购价付款条款，包括第二笔付款 RM2,994,000 及余款 RM5,988,000，并将先决条件截止日延至 2026 年 7 月 31 日。
actions.text_en: The company and the vendors agreed on 8 July 2026 to vary the payment terms of the balance purchase price, comprising a second payment of RM2,994,000 and a final payment of RM5,988,000, and extended the cut-off date for conditions precedent to 31 July 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司于 2026 年 3 月 11 日就收购 A Tech Insure 75% 股权提供额外资料。
actions.text_en: The company provided additional information on 11 March 2026 regarding the acquisition of the 75% equity stake in A Tech Insure.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司于 2026 年 3 月 9 日与卖方签署股份买卖协议，以总代价 RM9.98 million 收购 A Tech Insure Sdn Bhd 75% 股权。
actions.text_en: The company entered into a share sale agreement on 9 March 2026 to acquire a 75% equity stake in A Tech Insure Sdn Bhd for a total consideration of RM9.98 million.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司通过收购 A Tech Insure Sdn Bhd 75% 股权，将保险科技业务纳入集团。
model_changes.text_en: The company is adding insurtech to the group through the acquisition of a 75% equity stake in A Tech Insure Sdn Bhd.
